name: Observation/reference data provenance and immutable-package verification
purpose: Verify required Dxx package identity, native metadata, hashes, reproducibility, QA, and frozen selections without judging model agreement.
production_capability: Validation-data preflight shared by all data-dependent tests.
production_entry_points: canonical moon_validation_data packages and preparation scripts
configuration: Dataset list declared by the requesting test; raw files read-only.
independent_reference: Native labels/headers plus recomputed SHA-256 and deterministic script reproduction.
deterministic_stochastic_controls: Deterministic processing; no model residuals used.
procedure: Validate schema/status, recompute hashes, verify raw immutability, rerun processing in a temporary output, compare products, and freeze selections.
acceptance_criteria: Every required artifact present and consistent; QA READY/PASS; deterministic outputs match; unknown blocking metadata causes SKIP/ERROR.
expected_pass_result: The selected package is reproducible and scientifically eligible for its target test.
data_hashes: mixed local states: D04 QA PASS; D06 QA ERROR; D07 QA INCOMPLETE; D08 PROVISIONAL_NOT_FROZEN; D09 QA PASS; D10 QA PASS but its README says the available processed product is incomplete; D11 QA PASS; D12 recovered-summary status N/A; D13/D14 PARTIAL or provisional; D15 INCOMPLETE; D01-D03 absent
status_semantics: PASS is data-package QA only and never observational validation.
skip_reason: A target Dxx package was not specified, and the canonical root contains mixed readiness states; a blanket PASS would be false.
missing_capability: Runner selection of a specific Dxx package and package-specific reproduction command.
